name: wide-selectivity-scan
description: Compare broad physical scans with full COUNT and SUM baselines

queries.name: broad-range-sum
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE event_id BETWEEN 1 AND 9000

queries.name: broad-range-count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_id BETWEEN 1 AND 9000

queries.name: common-status-count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE status = 'paid'

queries.name: broad-paid-sum
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE event_id >= 100 AND status = 'paid'
